lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice following a less scaffolded announcement and identifying sequence and implication.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Hearing a building announcement about planned maintenance and temporary access changes.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Understanding what happens first, what follows, and what residents need to do.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss an audio announcement from their housing association about maintenance in the entrance and laundry room.

main_focus.name: sequence markers in reported information
main_focus.description: Use time and sequence markers to explain the order of events in a practical announcement.
model_examples: Först stängs entrén av på morgonen.
Därefter kan man använda den andra ingången.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use sequence markers naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: V2 after först, sedan, därefter, under tiden

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Prioritize sequence chunks and practical housing vocabulary.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person mentions an announcement that was a little fast or dense.
dialogue_shape.middle: They reconstruct the order of events, identify one temporary rule, and infer the practical effect.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree how to handle the temporary access change.

target_complexity.repetition: sequence markers should organize the dialogue clearly

focus: what happens first in the announcement

sentence_focus: one sentence explaining a temporary access change
one sentence with passive announcement language
one sentence checking what was heard correctly
